manifest.title: Countdown
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Counts the days, hours, and minutes until a future date or time.
manifest.code:
import os, json
from datetime import datetime

s = (os.environ.get('TARGET') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or '').strip()
try:
    if not s:
        raise ValueError('no target date given')
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    now = datetime.now(t.tzinfo) if t.tzinfo else datetime.now()
    delta = t - now
    total = int(delta.total_seconds())
    if total <= 0:
        result = 'that date is in the past'
        days = 0
    else:
        days = total // 86400
        hours = (total % 86400) // 3600
        minutes = (total % 3600) // 60
        result = f'{days} days, {hours} hours, {minutes} minutes'
    print(json.dumps({'result': result, 'days': days}))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({'result': f'invalid date: {e} (use ISO like 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T18:00)', 'days': 0}))

manifest.title: Dice Notation Roller
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Rolls dice using standard NdM+K notation and shows the breakdown.
manifest.code:
import os, re, json, random
spec=(os.environ.get('NOTATION') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or '1d20').strip().lower()
try:
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(\d*)d(\d+)([+-]\d+)?', spec.replace(' ',''))
    if not m:
        raise ValueError('use NdM+K notation, e.g. 1d20, 3d6+2, 2d8-1')
    count=int(m.group(1) or '1')
    sides=int(m.group(2))
    mod=int(m.group(3) or '0')
    if count < 1 or count > 1000 or sides < 1:
        raise ValueError('count must be 1-1000 and sides >= 1')
    rolls=[random.randint(1, sides) for _ in range(count)]
    total=sum(rolls)+mod
    print(json.dumps({'total': total, 'rolls': rolls}))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({'total': 0, 'rolls': str(e)}))

manifest.title: Extract Emails
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Finds all email addresses in a block of text.
manifest.code:
import os, re, json
try:
    text = os.environ.get('TEXT') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or os.environ.get('MESSAGE') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or ''
    pattern = r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}'
    found = re.findall(pattern, text)
    seen = set()
    emails = []
    for e in found:
        k = e.lower()
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            emails.append(e)
    print(json.dumps({'result': '\n'.join(emails), 'count': len(emails)}))
except Exception as ex:
    print(json.dumps({'result': '', 'count': 0, 'error': str(ex)}))

manifest.title: Strip Markdown
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Removes common markdown formatting to produce plain text.
manifest.code:
import os, re
try:
    t = os.environ.get('TEXT') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or os.environ.get('MESSAGE') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or ''
    # links [text](url) -> text ; images ![alt](url) -> alt
    t = re.sub(r'!?\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)', r'\1', t)
    # headers at line start: ###, ## ...
    t = re.sub(r'(?m)^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s*', '', t)
    # blockquotes at line start
    t = re.sub(r'(?m)^\s{0,3}>\s?', '', t)
    # bold/italic: ** __ * _
    t = re.sub(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', r'\1', t)
    t = re.sub(r'__([^_]+)__', r'\1', t)
    t = re.sub(r'\*([^*]+)\*', r'\1', t)
    t = re.sub(r'_([^_]+)_', r'\1', t)
    # inline code `code`
    t = re.sub(r'`([^`]*)`', r'\1', t)
    print(t.strip())
except Exception as e:
    print((os.environ.get('TEXT') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or ''))

manifest.title: Invisible Ink (ZWSP)
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Hides a secret message inside zero-width characters appended to cover text.
manifest.code:
import os
try:
    cover = os.environ.get('TEXT') or os.environ.get('INPUT') or os.environ.get('MESSAGE') or ''
    secret = os.environ.get('SECRET') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or ''
    data = secret.encode('utf-8')
    bits = ''.join(format(b, '08b') for b in data)
    hidden = ''.join('\u200b' if c == '0' else '\u200c' for c in bits)
    print(cover + hidden)
except Exception as e:
    print('error: ' + str(e))

manifest.title: Countdown
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Time remaining until a date/time, e.g. '2026-12-31' or '2026-12-31 09:00'.
manifest.code:
import os,datetime
s=(os.environ.get('WHEN') or os.environ.get('ARGS') or '').strip()
dt=None
for f in ('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M','%Y-%m-%d','%d/%m/%Y','%H:%M'):
    try: dt=datetime.datetime.strptime(s,f); break
    except: pass
if not dt: print("date like 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31 09:00"); raise SystemExit
now=datetime.datetime.now()
if dt.year==1900: dt=dt.replace(year=now.year,month=now.month,day=now.day)
d=dt-now; secs=int(d.total_seconds())
if secs<0: print('that was '+str(-d).split('.')[0]+' ago'); raise SystemExit
days=secs//86400; h=secs%86400//3600; m=secs%3600//60
print(f'{days}d {h}h {m}m until {dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}')

manifest.title: Edit File
manifest.subtitle: community
manifest.description: Replaces text in a file (first match, or all). Wire AI Tool args into file/find/replace.
manifest.code:
import os
root=os.environ.get('ROOT','')
f=os.environ.get('FILE','')
find=os.environ.get('FIND','')
repl=os.environ.get('REPLACE','')
allv=os.environ.get('ALL','false').lower()=='true'
p=os.path.join(root,f) if root else f
try:
    if find=='':
        print('ERROR: empty find'); raise SystemExit
    s=open(p,errors='replace').read()
    n=s.count(find)
    if n==0:
        print('not found: '+find); raise SystemExit
    s=s.replace(find,repl) if allv else s.replace(find,repl,1)
    open(p,'w').write(s)
    print('replaced '+str(n if allv else 1)+' occurrence(s) in '+f)
except SystemExit: raise
except Exception as e:
    print('ERROR: '+str(e))
